The blog is a true representative of it. In this blog, you’ll discover:

  • Family visit visa UAE eligibility criteria
  • Required documents for a family visit visa
  • Tips for a successful visit visa application
  • How does Royal Visa assist you in obtaining your family visa

Navigate the journey to welcoming your family with open arms in the UAE. The long wait is over! Be ready to meet your loved ones soon.

Eligibility Criteria for a Family Visit Visa

Minimum Age Requirement for Sponsors

You must meet the age requirement as set by the UAE government. If you are sponsoring your wife, you can sponsor two wives. However, you must meet certain terms set out by the GDRFA. In the case of other family members, let’s suppose your children. Still, you can sponsor them if they are 18 or under. If the age of your children is over 18, you can sponsor them. Note that, if they are students, and only up to the age of 21.

Income Requirements for Sponsors

There are different requirements for specific genders. Male expats have an earning of a minimum of AED 4,000 per month. However, they can also apply for a UAE family visit visa. Given that, if they are earning AED 3,000 per month plus accommodation.

Further, female expats have a minimum monthly earning of AED 10,000. They can also obtain a family visit visa if they earn less than AED 8,000 plus accommodation.

Residency Status

A sponsor should be legally authorized to live in the UAE. If they do not have a legal permit, they cannot sponsor.

Required Documents for a Family Visit Visa in UAE

To obtain a visa, gather and present a set of essential documents. We have mentioned some documents below. These documents include:

Passport Copy of the Visitor

To apply, the applicant must submit a valid passport copy of a visitor. The passport has at least six months of validity.

Passport-Sized Photos

On obtaining a visa for family, submit the recent personal photograph of a visitor along with the application.

Relation proof between sponsor & visitor

A marriage certificate is a must when applying for a spouse. A copy of the marriage certificate must be submitted to obtain a UAE visa for your spouse.

Make sure all required documents are available. They must be verified beforehand. So, before applying gather all documents to ensure a smooth visa acquisition process.

Tips for a Successful Family Visit Visa Application in UAE

A great way to bring your loved ones together is a Family Visit Visa Dubai. You can sponsor them for a short stay, holiday, or special event. The application process can be straightforward. We are going to share key steps. It helps you ensure that your visa application goes smoothly. Let’s move on to expert tips for a hassle-free Family Visit Visa application.

Meet the Requirements

Must meet the eligibility criteria before you begin the application process. The UAE allows residents to sponsor a family member. These may include:

  • Spouses
  • Children
  • Parents
  • In some cases, siblings are under certain conditions.

Gather the Right Documentation

Prepare the necessary documents. Missing or incorrect paperwork can cause delays or even rejection.

Double-check the Visa Duration and Type

The Family Visit Visa UAE allows for a stay of 30 to 90 days. However, the exact duration can vary depending on factors such as:

  • The family member being sponsored
  • Your status as a sponsor
  • Government regulations at the time of application

Be clear about the visit visa type you are applying for. This will dictate the allowed duration of stay and the possibility of extensions

Apply Through the Right Channels

The UAE government provides a variety of ways to apply for a Dubai family visit visa. You can apply online, at typing centers, or at GDRFA. Among them, the online application process is the most convenient. Apply through the UAE’s official portal or using the Dubai or Abu Dhabi government’s visa services.

Pay Attention to Processing Times

The processing time for a family visit visa can vary. However, it takes anywhere from 3 to 7 working days. Apply well in advance of the planned arrival date to avoid delays. Especially if the visa application is being processed during peak seasons

Be Prepared for Health and Security Checks

All visitors to the UAE may be subject to medical and security checks. These may include family members on visit visas as well.

Follow-Up on Visa Status

Track application status online after Family Visit Visa application submission. Keep an eye on updates. Respond promptly if you receive a request for additional information. This helps you to avoid delays.

Ensure Compliance with Visa Terms

Ensure your family members must comply with the visa terms on their arrival. Note that, a Visa does not permit the visitor to work while in the country. Additionally, avoid overstaying. It can lead to fines, penalties, or even deportation.

Extension and Renewal Options

You can extend a visit visa for family for another 30 days.  However, this is not always guaranteed. The extension applications must be filed before the visa expires.
